description:
Move the `dep add`, `dep rm` and `query` argument-guard cases that only the exit-code suite tests beside the tests of those commands.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/cli_issue/exit_code_tests.rs` (39 subprocess tests) re-proves projected exit codes and also owns behaviour no other test owns. The exit-code projection suite owns command-to-exit-code bindings and their human/machine parity: outside it, a subprocess test asserts success or failure and the property it adds, and names a numeric exit code only for a command and code pair the projection has no row for. This entry covers these cases:

- `:1372` and `:1447`: a too-short and an ambiguous prefix in both `dep add` positions.
- `:1315`: symmetric argument validation for `dep rm`.
- `:1280`: the guard against a parent filter given before the `query` subcommand ("were given before", `INVALID_ARGUMENT`); the string appears only in `main.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The `dep add` and `dep rm` cases have owning tests in `cli_query_graph/dep_add_redundancy_cli_tests.rs`, and the parent-filter guard has one in `cli_query_graph/query_json_tests.rs`, each with the same non-exit assertions.
- [hard] REQ-02: A moved case names a numeric exit code only where the projection has no row for its command and code.
- [hard] REQ-03: A behaviour an existing test there already owns is not duplicated.
title: Dependency and query argument-guard cases move beside their owners
